title: [K-Poppin'] "Singlish" Day with DKB(다크비) :So many layers from 🎵 Curious🧐
description:
Learn Korean and English on "Singlish" every Monday! DKB joins us every week to learn a pop song the listeners chose! Penalties await too! Every Monday from 1-2pm kst don't forget to join in!

💛 Today’s Guests: D1, 이찬(E-CHAN), 룬(LUNE) from DKB(다크비)

💛 Today’s Singlish:  호기심 (Curious)-DKB ❤️ 🔥
